identitySignals: OUSD agenda item (File 25-0956) names the vendor 'Coast2Coast Coaching' with dba 'Elevo Learning', located in San Diego, CA

Elevo Learning's own privacy policy names its legal entity as 'Coast 2 Coast Coaching, Inc. doing business as Elevo Learning' at 4666 Cass St. Suite #200, San Diego, CA 92109, matching the agenda location
Elevo Learning's website describes expanded-learning, sports and wellness programs for schools, matching OUSD's after-school, summer and student-support contracts
research.notes: Not to be confused with Elevo Institute (elevo.org), an unrelated Australian nonprofit. No California Secretary of State entity number or SAM UEI was verified. The only email found (privacy@elevolearning.com) is a privacy-specific inbox, so email is left null.

profile.address: 4666 Cass St. Suite #200, San Diego, CA 92109
profile.summary: A San Diego company that does business as Elevo Learning. It runs in-school and out-of-school programs for schools, including expanded learning programs, sports, school day activities and wellness coaching with a focus on social-emotional learning.

review.notes: OUSD titles name 'Coast2Coast Coaching dba Elevo Learning' (San Diego), and the Elevo privacy policy names 'Coast 2 Coast Coaching, Inc. doing business as Elevo Learning' at 4666 Cass St, San Diego with phone (323) 484-2402. The homepage supports the neutral summary of expanded learning, sports, school day and wellness programs with an SEL focus.
